listing.name: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild (MacNativeGames)
listing.summary: Build the Switch edition of Breath of the Wild for Apple silicon Mac or iPhone using your own base game and a supported 1.6.0 or 1.9.0 update. The project reports Great Plateau play on Mac and iPhone play on 1.6.0.
listing.original_game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild

steps.title: Check your original game files
steps.instruction: Use title 01007EF00011E000, the matching 1.6.0 or 1.9.0 update, your prod.keys and firmware or shared fonts. The project accepts combined 1.6.0 cards with DLC or a separate base and update without DLC. Supply any 1.9.0 DLC separately as titles 01007EF00011F001 and 01007EF00011F002.

steps.title: Follow the project’s setup
steps.instruction: Use the project’s Python 3.14 build_app.py to build the Mac app or an IPA to sign and install. The Mac needs Apple silicon, macOS 26 or later and Metal 4. The iPhone route needs iOS 26 or later and an iPhone 14 or later.

warnings: Back up the profile before rebuilding or launching an update. Keep the backup if you might return to the older version.

references.title: Version and platform notes
references.instruction: The project reports Mac opening scenes, saves and selected DLC scenes. Sound and performance vary by scene and version. Its iOS 1.9.0 build has no play report.
